responsibility: instantiate one or more WebGUI runtimes
compose application UI from WebGUI primitives
mustNot: contain acoustic equations that belong in domain solvers
fork or modify reusable S3D domain modules as AcousticMate-owned implementation
mutate module internals outside public contracts
model acoustic absorbers or diffusors as application objects
recommend absorber or diffusor placement automatically

rules: a single AcousticMate clone contains all browser runtime dependencies
vendored directories are immutable upstream snapshots from the application's perspective
framework changes are made in their owning repositories and then refreshed into vendor

primaryFlow: bind every speaker model to a draggable S3D SpeakerNode instance
configure each speaker signal chain and crossover routing
invalidate and resample the visible field continuously while any speaker moves
select single frequency or frequency range
